name: ensoniqplaystdinpipe
description: ensoniqplay(1) M4 stdin streaming: pipe a 44100-byte raw 8-bit PCM (2 s at 22050 Hz) into 'ensoniqplay -' via a real shell pipe (cat | ensoniqplay), so stdin is a non-seekable pipe.  The tool fills a 64 KB RAM ring from stdin (foreground producer) while the sound IRQ drains it to the DOC double-buffer (consumer).  'streaming from stdin' proves the pipe path; 'finished after 1' (100-199 ticks; 44100/22050 = 2.0 s = ~120 ticks) proves the ring engine clocked the whole stream at rate; '0 underruns' proves the producer stayed ahead of the consumer (the ring never starved).
